Name: Ghostly Junimos
Author: PrettyPoisn
Description:
The Junimos decided they felt a little festive this fall season and have decided to dress up as little ghosts! There are two variations of this mod. One has settings so the junimos only dress up in the fall and the other is a year round mod if you have a spooky farm and want lil ghosties year round!

+.*Remember i you want your junimos on the farm to be a classic white ghosts you will need to give them a diamond, quartz, lunarite, or soapstone*.+

To install make sure you have content patcher and then chose the appropriate file depending on weather you'd like year round ghosts or fall ghosts. download, unzip, and drop into your mods folder and you're ready to play!

[b]Please note that if you use better junimos and the year round ghosts you will have to disable the winter sprites from better junimos for them to be ghostly year round as better junimos takes priority.[/b]
